critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/lib/cloudinary.js: single postForm() call uses XMLHttpRequest with `xhr.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Upload network error'))`. That's the exact toast users reported before this iteration; it still fires when a chunked leg fails. Consider surfacing the chunk index (`Error('Upload network error on chunk N/M')`) so the next bug report is diagnosable. The 90MB threshold + 20MB chunk size are reasonable, but there's no per-chunk retry — a single flaky chunk on a 500MB upload throws away the entire session. Recommend at least one retry per chunk with exponential backoff.

/app/frontend/src/lib/cloudinary.js: `uploadChunked` returns only the LAST chunk's response, which is the one Cloudinary flags as 'done' with full metadata — this is correct — but `secure_url` presence is only asserted in the single-shot branch (`if (!data.secure_url) throw...`). If the chunked path ever returns a partial 200 without secure_url, callers will silently create a post with `undefined` video_url. Suggest moving that guard to a shared unwrap step.

/app/frontend/src/components/PostComposer.jsx: `res.secure_url.replace(/\.(mp4|mov|webm|m4v)$/i, '.jpg')` for the video thumbnail — same brittle regex flagged in iter29. Cloudinary will happily accept .avi/.mkv/.3gp uploads and this regex leaves the extension intact, producing a 404 thumbnail. Prefer building the poster URL from the Cloudinary public_id (returned in the same response) with resource_type=video, format=jpg.

/app/frontend/src/pages/VideoUpload.jsx line 50: `if (result.thumbnail_url) setThumbnailUrl(result.thumbnail_url)` — Cloudinary's video upload response doesn't include a `thumbnail_url` field; it exposes `eager[]` or requires the public_id transform. This branch is effectively dead code today, so VideoUpload posts are always going out with `thumbnail_url: null` (which is why the Profile grid shows blank tiles for uploaded videos). Compute it client-side from public_id or ask backend to derive it.

/app/backend/server.py RegisterBody (line 98-102): `password: str = Field(min_length=6)` — only 6 chars, no complexity checks. Login uses bcrypt so brute-forcing at 6 chars alphanumeric is still practical. Consider bumping to 8 with at least one letter+digit. Also `username: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=20)` is fine but there's no regex — a username like `..` or `@@@` would pass validation.

rca of the issue: Bug 1 (Upload Network Fail on video): Cloudinary's unsigned single-shot upload silently drops connections around ~100MB. The old uploadToCloudinary did a single XHR POST; XHR.onerror fired -> `Upload network error` toast. Fix in /app/frontend/src/lib/cloudinary.js: files >90MB now stream in 20MB Content-Range chunks with a shared X-Unique-Upload-Id, and the last chunk returns the final response (secure_url + duration). Confirmed no regression on small files (single-shot path unchanged). Bug 2 (Verified badge missing): could NOT reproduce in preview. Backend returns is_verified=true for the founder on /api/users/{id} and /auth/me; Profile.jsx line 104 renders <BadgeCheck> when target.is_verified. Badge visibly renders on /profile and on /user/<founderId>, and absent on the non-verified test user. Most likely the reporter was on a stale prod build — recommend cache-bust/redeploy prod.
